# GNU tar

Pinned local vendor copy from `C:/msys64/usr/bin/tar.exe`. Active payload lives directly under `tools/toolbelt/third_party/tar`. Runtime DLLs are resolved through `vendor.msys2.runtime.usr` in `tools/toolbelt/libraries`.

Legacy GNUWin32 payload, if present, is preserved under `legacy_gnuwin32/` and is not active.
